arm_bonding.method: Radial exported-mesh sections every degree at the band centre; bonded where the section exceeds the R7 wall profile by more than 0.15 mm.

lead_in_skirt.method: Native ray sections of the exported assembly STL through the skirt on 4 angles per 1 mm layer step, at least 1 mm inside the sloped leading edge, with actual bead-centre clusters on each ray.

band_start_backing.reference_failure: R15 XIAO far clip face: 0.9 percent directly backed over a separate helper.

Battery_Holder.feature: U-channel: whole section, every layer between the gate guides and the end plate
Battery_Holder.load_case: Cell weight, rod loads and any toolhead contact during printing load this section.
Battery_Holder.decision: Continuous floor, side walls and roof flanges in one wall loop per layer.
Battery_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.feature: Rails, keel, struts and retainer posts, every layer
XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: Board and USB loads pass along the rails into both ring planes.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: Rails 2 x 2.8 mm, keel, struts as R16 with the rail moved 0.8 mm outward.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.feature: Near +X contact ledge, top 0.45 mm under the board, every layer
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: Contact only ahead of the first solder pad.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: A board corner rests here; it stands on the bed.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.feature: Near post +X through the groove, every layer
XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: The plate bears here if the board or a wire pulls upward.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: C-section of floor, outer wall and lip, carried straight into the rail.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.feature: Groove lip +X over the plate, every layer
XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: Holds the plate down; the upward load path of the retainer.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: A short lip tied to the outer wall in every layer.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: Holds the USB end down, including a tug on the cable. Loaded across layers, so its strength is a physical test.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: Tied to the rail along its length and standing on the bed-side block, not on a free cantilever.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.
